Risk Description / Event: Cold-Start & Inaccurate Match: Candidates with sparse or unverified initial skill entries receive zero or irrelevant job recommendations from the cosine radar engine.
Mitigation Strategy (Preventative Plan): Enforce onboarding requirement of at least 3 baseline skills; implement hybrid matching combining domain taxonomy keywords with vector cosine embeddings.
Contingency Plan (Action if Triggered): Fallback to role-based exploratory recommendations and trigger missing evidence popups highlighting required skills.

Risk Description / Event: Profile Evidence Fabrication: Candidates submit non-functional GitHub repositories, broken certificate URLs, or falsified project proofs to inflate their Trust Score.
Impact Area: Skill Trust Index Credibility & Recruiter Confidence
Risk Owner: and require checkpoint aptitude/technical quizzes before awarding Verified badges.
Status: Flag suspicious evidence with 'Missing Proof' badges; restrict recruiter pipeline visibility to only authenticated verified credentials.

Risk Description / Event: Client-Side Latency & UI Freezing: Intensive vector calculations and animated radar sweeps cause browser lag and sluggish assessment timer counters on mobile devices.
Mitigation Strategy (Preventative Plan): Debounce radar filter triggers; optimize DOM manipulation; offload vector math into lightweight asynchronous routines; cache precomputed opportunity scores.
Contingency Plan (Action if Triggered): Disable radar sweep animations automatically on low-spec client devices; paginate opportunities list into chunks of 10 items.

Risk Description / Event: Scope Creep Across Dual Portals: Simultaneous feature expansion across Student Readiness dashboards and Recruiter Shortlisting leads to milestone slippage.
Mitigation Strategy (Preventative Plan): Establish strict milestone boundaries (Phase 1-3 Student Core focus
Contingency Plan (Action if Triggered): Phase 4-5 Matching & Trust); isolate recruiter workflows into secondary sprint cycles.
Risk Owner: Freeze new non-essential UI features; shift team pairing to unblock critical path assessment and opportunity radar tasks.

Risk Description / Event: Assessment Test Fatigue: Candidates drop off mid-way through rigorous multi-question timed aptitude assessments, leaving readiness profiles incomplete.
Mitigation Strategy (Preventative Plan): Structure assessments into bite-sized 5-question micro-checkpoints; implement real-time progress bars
Status: Save quiz progress automatically in localStorage; dispatch non-intrusive reminder alerts guiding users to resume incomplete checkpoints.
